question: What baseline time-aware retrieval techniques exist for versioned documents that we should compare against in our evaluation?
description: To claim novelty, we need to understand existing time-aware approaches for versioned documents (e.g., time-travel queries, temporal indexing) and ensure our method is distinct and superior.
confidence_basis: Based on analyzed papers showing various temporal IR approaches with documented performance.
rationale: We found some work on time-travel phrase queries and time-aware random walks, but a systematic survey of baselines is needed.
resolution: Identified baselines include Re3 (learned gating), tempRALM, TempRetriever, TSM (heuristic fusion), and temporal graph-based methods. Need to determine which are most appropriate for versioned regulatory QA comparison.
